name: gift-card-scam-guard
title: Gift Card Scam Guard
description: Gift card checkout check. Spots scam patterns (large total, several cards, notes about a boss, tax, police, refunds or tech support, sending codes, a first order), says no real company takes gift-card payment, and asks one question; "someone asked me to" ends at a stop screen.

meta.stops: Helps stop a buyer paying a scammer in gift cards
meta.summary: Interrupts a gift card checkout that looks like a scam payment and asks one question before the order goes through.
meta.server: Apply your own fraud and velocity rules on gift card orders server-side; the client prompt is advisory.
catches: Large total or several cards in one order, scaled to the order currency
Notes that mention a boss, tax, police, refunds, tech support or sharing codes
Common Hinglish and Hindi scam phrases such as "sir ne bola"
Someone else asking the buyer to pay: routes to a stop screen instead of checkout
limits: Keyword and threshold heuristics; a scam with an innocent note and small total is not flagged
Genuine gifts that match the patterns are asked the question too
The buyer can still choose to continue; it does not block payment on its own
a11y: Question section is labelled by its heading; the stop screen is role=alert
A polite live region announces changes; focus moves to the relevant control after each step
Continue button is described by its waiting reason when disabled
